title: Crispy Korean Tofu Dumplings
description: A crispy and flavorful Asian-inspired dish featuring pan-fried dumplings filled with marinated tofu, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Prepare the marinade by whisking together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and ginger in a shallow dish.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and add it to the marinade. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook until the bottom is golden brown (about 2-3 minutes).
Flip the dumplings and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the skillet and set them aside on a plate.
Increase the heat to high and add the remaining 1/4 cup of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown (about 3-4 minutes).
Add the green onions to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the tofu and green onions on top of the crispy dumplings.
